verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-prevention SaaS with SDKs and an embedded Beacon, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such control. The Beacon docs describe data collection used for fraud decisioning but never mention any user-facing opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
